camp-shelter.granted_by: [A Roof before Nightfall](../cards/a-roof-before-nightfall.md) on learning; also Ordinary Recipe Study when compatible.
camp-shelter.completion:
Weak / Standard / Strong: add **1 / 2 / 3 progress** toward **target 4**. Reject unsuitable materials before consuming them.

On completion, shelter yourself and up to **six companions** from ordinary rain and wind. This is not fortification or protection against extreme weather. The DA states visible material and site limits before work begins.

**Strong completion:** pack the intact shelter in ten minutes into one Bulk 1 bundle; erect it in one hour without another roll or materials. Otherwise, dismantling requires rebuilding. The shelter lasts until dismantled or damaged.
